bodyHtml:
ROT-44 Reverse Osmosis Storage Tank

160-Liter (44 Gallon) Extra-High Capacity Tank for Commercial Systems, Schools & Public Facilities | Aquasky RO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

The ROT-44 is an extra-large 160-liter (44-gallon) pressure tank designed for commercial reverse osmosis systems, including standard shops, large restaurants, schools, and public activities, serving up to 40 people with safe, pure, high-pressure water. 

 

It has a maximum operating pressure of 7 bar (100 psi) and a maximum temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). Pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to 0.5 - 0.7 bar (7-10 psi) for stable performance unaffected by temperature. 

 

This stand-model tank measures 55.0 cm (21.7 inches) in diameter and 93.3 cm (36.7 inches) in height, featuring a heavy-duty plastic base for sturdy support in high-traffic commercial environments.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-44 is a 160-liter (44 gallon) diaphragm pressure tank engineered specifically as a high-capacity Commercial Reverse Osmosis (RO) drinking tank. Designed to process 160 liters per hour, the ROT-44 securely stores a massive volume of purified water and delivers it into the plumbing system with controlled, steady pressure.

ROT-44 is ideal for commercial and public applications. Its highly hygienic internal design separates the stored water from the compressed gas and completely prevents water from making direct contact with the internal metallic tank shell. Utilizing a polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-compliant butyl rubber diaphragm, the ROT-44 ensures exceptionally safe operation, delivering cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water while maintaining a tasteless water zone absolutely free of any rubber or plastic smells.

Manufactured with premium materials and holding top-tier certifications including CE and IAPMO, Aquasky RO tanks are produced in ISO 9001:2008 registered facilities to deliver a long service life, dependable performance, and the safest drinking-water compatibility on the market.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Epoxy powder exterior paint for high protection against oxidation and fine finish.
  • Stainless-steel water connection: lead-free, chemical-free, patented leak-safe technology (Aquasky invention in 18 years).
  • High-performance butyl rubber diaphragm meets DIN 4807.
  • Internal virgin FDA-approved polypropylene liner prevents water-to-metal contact.
  • Patented leakage-free O-ring sealed air valve cap.
  • 100% factory pre-charged with nitrogen (not air).
  • 100% pressure tested before shipment for ultimate reliability.
  • High customization available for distinct market branding.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the RO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

ROT-44 stores supplemental water securely between the butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber maintains constant system pressure. When a drinking tap or coffee maker is activated, the compressed nitrogen pushes the purified water into the system at a controlled pressure.

This specialized design ensures stable performance, completely separates the water from the metal shell, and maintains a clean water zone that is completely free of rubber or plastic odors.

Key benefits

  • Delivers cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water by isolating the water supply from metals and plastics
  • Provides a tasteless water zone with absolutely no rubber or plastic smells
  • Guarantees zero air loss and exceptional air resistance, outperforming other tanks on the market
  • Completely maintenance-free during its entire expected service life

Typical Applications

  • Commercial Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems (160L per hour production)
  • Schools and public activity centers
  • Standard shops and large restaurants (eg, tables of 30) suitable for up to 40 people

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Can the ROT-44 support a school's drinking water needs?

Yes, as the largest in the ROT series, the ROT-44 holds 160 liters (44 gallons) and supports a massive commercial system rate of 160 liters per hour. It is perfectly suited for schools, large public activities, and 30-table restaurants serving around 40 people.
 

Q2 : Does the ROT-44 require regular maintenance or air recharging?

No. The ROT-44 is designed to be entirely maintenance-free during its service life. We utilize a specialized brass cap with an internal  O-ring that guarantees no air loss from the air vent. 

Additionally, it is the only RO storage tank in the industry pre-charged with 100% Nitrogen, which naturally resists permeation and prevents pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes.

Q3 : What makes Aquasky RO tanks the industry standard?

AQUASKY invented the leak-safe technology applied to the stainless connector 18 years ago, setting the benchmark for drinking water tanks. Manufactured in an ISO 9001:2008 registered facility and holding top-tier certifications like NSF58 and CE, it is recognized as one of the safest pressure vessels in the market.
